tools.name: mandu.agent.context
tools.description: Official agent-core entry point. Returns one structured project context for Codex/Claude/Gemini: project metadata, routes/APIs, partials/islands, slots/contracts, guard summary, diagnostics, git state, and the canonical context -> plan -> apply -> verify -> repair workflow.

cwd.description: Project directory to inspect. Defaults to the MCP project root.

includeDiagnose.description: Include diagnose summary and normalized diagnostics. Defaults to true.

includeGit.description: Include git branch and changed-file summary. Defaults to true.

writeManifest.description: Write .mandu/agent-manifest.json while building context. Defaults to false.

tools.name: mandu.agent.plan
tools.description: Official agent-core planning entry point. Converts a natural-language Mandu task into a conservative domain plan with files to inspect, files likely to create, preferred MCP/domain tools, risks, and verification commands.

cwd.description: Project directory to plan against. Defaults to the MCP project root.

intent.description: Natural-language task request, for example: add authenticated dashboard.

writePlan.description: Write .mandu/agent-plan.json while planning. Defaults to false.

tools.name: mandu.agent.apply
tools.description: Official agent-core apply preview. Reads an agent plan and returns ordered intent-level actions. This initial implementation is dry-run only and does not mutate project files.

cwd.description: Project directory. Defaults to the MCP project root.

from.description: Plan path relative to cwd. Defaults to .mandu/agent-plan.json.

dryRun.description: Return a dry-run action report. Defaults to true.

tools.name: mandu.agent.verify
tools.description: Official agent-core verification entry point. Returns one structured report that combines changed files, diagnose, route manifest, guard, contract consistency, normalized diagnostics, and suggested follow-up commands.

cwd.description: Project directory to verify. Defaults to the MCP project root.

changedOnly.description: Filter guard/contract findings to changed files when git data exists. Defaults to true.

includeDiagnose.description: Run diagnose and include normalized diagnose diagnostics. Defaults to true.

includeGit.description: Collect git changed files. Defaults to true.

includeGuard.description: Run architecture guard if the routes manifest is available. Defaults to true.

includeContract.description: Run contract/slot consistency checks if the routes manifest is available. Defaults to true.

staged.description: Use staged changes only. Defaults to false.

base.description: Optional git base ref for changed-file detection.

writeReport.description: Write .mandu/agent-verify.json while verifying. Defaults to false.

tools.name: mandu.agent.repair
tools.description: Official agent-core repair entry point. Reads an agent verify report and returns structured next actions. It does not execute shell commands; apply mode only handles safe typed patch candidates.

cwd.description: Project directory. Defaults to the MCP project root.

from.description: Verify report path relative to cwd. Defaults to .mandu/agent-verify.json.

apply.description: Apply safe typed patch candidates only. Defaults to false.

tools.name: mandu.agent.sync
tools.description: Official agent sync helper. Writes or previews Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI workflow artifacts under .mandu/agent-sync so each agent follows the same Mandu agent loop and MCP profile guidance.

cwd.description: Project directory. Defaults to the MCP project root.

target.description: Agent target to sync. Defaults to all.

dryRun.description: Preview files without writing. Defaults to false.

tools.name: mandu.docs.search
tools.description: Search the project's docs/ markdown tree by keyword. Returns ranked slugs + excerpts so agents can ground answers in Mandu documentation instead of hallucinating. Read-only. Pass `scope` (e.g. 'architect' or 'bun') to narrow to a subdirectory; `includeBody:true` returns the full MDX body for each hit.

scope.description: Restrict search to a `docs/` subdirectory (e.g. 'architect', 'bun'). Default 'all'.

limit.description: Maximum results returned. Default 5, capped at 25.

includeBody.description: Return the full markdown body for each hit. Default false (excerpt only).

tools.name: mandu.docs.get
tools.description: Fetch a single markdown page from the project's docs/ tree by relative slug (e.g. 'architect/rendering-modes.md'). Returns the full body + extracted title. Read-only. Pair with `mandu.docs.search` — search to discover, get to read.

slug.description: Relative path under docs/ (no leading slash, no '..'). Example: 'architect/rendering-modes.md'.
